value.summary: The change adds pricing entries for four additional models and four new unit tests that verify default-model coverage, the new tier's cost, cache-rate billing, and argument-order correctness. No security-sensitive operations are introduced: no new network calls, no deserialization of untrusted data, no path traversal, no secrets exposure, and no widened permissions. The tests validate internal consistency against hardcoded constants; the added pricing data is static and deterministic. The change is safe to merge.
